tasks.title: Email the next applicant when a plot frees up

messages.text: Request from the operator: when the committee marks a plot as vacant, the next person on the waiting list should get an email offering it, with a link to accept or decline within ten days. Today the secretary does this by hand from a spreadsheet, and offers sometimes go to people who already got a plot.

Plan: a vacancy creates an offer for the first applicant still waiting, and the offer email carries accept and decline links that expire after ten days. A declined or expired offer moves to the next applicant automatically, and applicants who already hold a plot are skipped. The secretary gets a 'Pause offers' switch for the weeks when the committee is still clearing a plot. One question about what a decline does to someone's place.

They keep their place. People decline because the plot is too far from home, not because they've lost interest.

Understood: a decline keeps the applicant's position, and the next offer for a different plot goes to them again. An expired offer (no answer in ten days) does move them to the back, since that usually means the address is dead. I've put that rule in the secretary's help text so it isn't a surprise.

The expiry job now handles the empty case explicitly rather than relying on a default three calls further down. The gate code never appears in any page a non-member can reach; I checked the logged-out view.

Review: fixed the double-offer race with a unique constraint on vacancy and applicant, and the raw date on the accept page. F1 I can't fix inside this task: the test suite has no way to capture outgoing mail, every send goes straight to the provider client, so the offer email itself is only checked by hand. Leaving it open in the report.
The plot numbers in the seed data skip 14 like the real site does, and the accept and decline links copes with that. The offer model is the last piece; I expect it to take an hour or so.

Done: PR #304 merged. A vacancy now offers the plot to the next waiting applicant, skipping current holders; declines keep their place, expiries go to the back. The offer email is untested (F1 open, no way to capture mail in tests).
